content.value_statement: Finding a specific Gmail message can be slow when you only need its content or headers. This skill retrieves one message by ID in text or JSON format for focused review.
actual_capabilities: Reads a Gmail message using its message ID.
Returns the message body as plain text by default.
Includes From, To, Subject, and Date headers when requested.
Returns message data in text or JSON format.
Returns the HTML body when the HTML option is requested.
Shows a request without executing it by using dry-run mode.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and configured Google Workspace authentication.
Reads one message at a time and requires a known Gmail message ID.
Does not search, send, modify, or delete Gmail messages.
Access is limited by the authenticated account permissions.

best_practices: Confirm the message ID before retrieving sensitive email content.
Use dry-run mode when validating a new command workflow.
Request headers only when message content is not needed.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to search for messages because it requires a message ID.
Do not share retrieved email content outside authorized workflows.
Do not assume access to messages beyond the authenticated account permissions.

faq.question: What does this skill read?
faq.answer: It reads one Gmail message identified by its Gmail message ID.

faq.question: Can it search my inbox?
faq.answer: No. You must provide a known Gmail message ID.

faq.question: Can it show message headers?
faq.answer: Yes. Request headers to include From, To, Subject, and Date.

faq.question: Can it return JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the format option to request JSON output.

faq.question: Can it return HTML email content?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the HTML option to request the HTML body.

faq.question: Does it change or delete email?
faq.answer: No. This skill is limited to reading a specified message.
